dataSource: NYC DOB Job Application Filings + DOB Violations (BIS and DOB NOW), queried live

coverage.type: Job filings (alterations, new buildings, demolitions, signs)

notes: Pulled live from three NYC Open Data Socrata datasets on every search, not a static extract — coverage reflects whatever DOB has published as of your search.
NYC job filings track work type across several separate fields rather than one description column; Tarn combines them into a single readable description.
DOB violations are classified by severity (high/medium/low) from the violation type and description text, matching NYC DOB's own violation categories.
summary: New York City is covered by a live query against NYC DOB's public job filing and violation systems — alteration and new-building filings alongside DOB Violations (BIS) and DOB Safety Violations (DOB NOW), matched by address as you search.
